title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: DANNY'S YEAR
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight, I'll tell you a story, in six famous quotes.
It's about a man called Danny, from Dayton, Ohio.
And it starts on the worst day of his year.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE COUCH
segments.quote: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.
segments.author: Albert Einstein
lines: Danny worked at the same factory for twelve years. Then one Monday, it closed.
For three weeks, he barely left the couch.
Then he found his old bike in the garage, and remembered something Albert Einstein once wrote.
Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
So the next morning, Danny got up and went for a ride. Small. But he was moving.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE JOB AD
segments.quote: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
segments.author: Wayne Gretzky
lines: A week later, he saw a job ad at a car repair shop.
He almost scrolled past. Surely they wanted someone younger. Someone better.
But Danny loved hockey, and his hero, Wayne Gretzky, used to say:
You miss one hundred percent of the shots you don't take.
So he applied. Two days later, the phone rang.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE SLOWEST GUY
segments.quote: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
segments.author: Confucius
lines: On his first day, Danny was the slowest guy in the shop. By a mile.
That night, his daughter stuck a note on the fridge. An old saying from Confucius:
It does not matter how slowly you go, as long as you do not stop.
So he didn't stop. And every week, he got a little faster.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE FLAT TIRE
segments.quote: No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
segments.author: Aesop
lines: One rainy evening, Danny saw an old man stuck with a flat tire.
He changed it, and wouldn't take a dime.
A month later, the man walked into the shop. He ran a delivery company with forty vans, and he wanted Danny to look after every one.
Aesop wrote that lesson thousands of years ago:
No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: NIGHT CLASSES
segments.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
segments.author: Nelson Mandela
lines: Now the shop needed a certified technician.
Danny hadn't opened a textbook in twenty years. He was terrified.
But he kept thinking of Nelson Mandela's words:
Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
So for six months, he studied at the kitchen table after dinner. And he passed.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE NEW GUY
segments.quote: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
segments.author: Lao Tzu
lines: Today, Danny runs that shop.
Last month, a new guy started. Nervous. Slow. Fresh off a layoff.
Danny smiled, and told him what the ancient Chinese thinker Lao Tzu said:
The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Keep moving. Take the shot. Don't stop. Be kind. Keep learning. Take the first step.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Keep moving. Take the shot. Don't stop. Be kind. Keep learning. And take that first step.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
